en: Her name is Ai Ishimori-chan. Ooh, I can't wait to meet her!
All right, here they come!
Nice to meet you all. I'm Ishimori.
Uh... Hi.
*giggle* Oh, please. Put the tongues away, boys. Haven't you ever seen a lady before?
AHAH! AHAHAHAH!
Oh, there's one more coming, but she's running a little late.
Hey, Kiyokawa. She doesn't look like an idol. Unless you mean those fat fertility ones ancient people used to worship!
Well, what do you want me to say? She looked cute enough on her blog profile.
That doesn't mean jack squat! You ought to know those are never how they actually look! Why can't you do anything right?
Yo! What are you guys whispering about over there?
Oh, nothing! Our bad.
Oh. No, that's okay. I get it.
Mhm. You nasty boys are already working out which one of us you want to take home with you, right? Oh, men and their one-track minds!

Slow down there, gentlemen. Can't get past first base if you
don't start in first gear! Oh, I made a funny! Ahahahahahah!
(This is going to be an awkward night.)
Okay, well. Shall we start off with introductions?
Sure. Us girls will go first. So, I'm Ishimori. Let's see, as for hobbies... Oh yeah, I like trying out the menu at different restaurants!
Yeah, I'll bet she orders the entire menu at once! Hey, Kiyokawa. Didn't you say her hobby was baking?
What are you looking at me for? Tell it to her. She's right there.
Yo! Are you guys even listening!?
Oh. Yeah. Of course! Nice to meet you!
Hmph. You're up next, Nakayama-san.
Okey-doke! Soooooo! I'm Yuki Nakayama! I'm always laughing about <Italic>something</Italic>⑬in fact, I'd laugh at the drop of a chopstick! AHAH... Ahah... Ahoo...
(She says she'll laugh at the drop of a chopstick. Let's test that out.)
*click* *clack* *clack*
Oh, your chopsticks, Suzuki-san!
There they go! Oohoo... Eeehee... AHAHAHAHAHA! *sniffle* Ohh... That was refreshing.
...Does she really have to laugh like that?
(At least it got the girls' side laughing. Hopefully that broke the ice a bit.)
(Laughing at the drop of a chopstick? That's silly. I won't bother testing it out.)
Hey! How come none of you are dropping your chopsticks? Can't you take a hint!?
Shit, sorry! Quick, drop your chopsticks, Suzuki-san!
Er, okay.
...That laugh's getting on my nerves.
(Damn. I didn't think she actually wanted us to do it. These mixers are tricky to navigate.)
Kondo-san! What kept you?
Oh, I just lost track of time. Anyway, I'm Kondo. Nice to meet you all.
She's... She's beautiful!
Oh, yeah, uh⑬nice to meet you, too!
(She's a fine-looking woman. Muramatsu-san and Kiyokawa can't seem to keep their eyes off her.)
So! Uh, what shall we do next? Hey, why don't you take the lead, Suzuki-san?
Me? Well, okay.
It might get a little uncomfortable, but it's better to be real with each other straight from the start. It's time... for the king's game.
Ooh, perfect! Now <Italic>this</Italic> is how you start a mixer!
Hey, isn't it a bit early to break out an intimate game like that? You guys haven't even told us who you are yet!
Eeep! We're sorry!
(Shoot. She's right. I guess I got a bit ahead of myself.)
Well, none of us guys have introduced ourselves yet. Let's start there.
Oh, right! I completely forgot. That was smooth, Suzuki-san!
Mm, I like me a man who can keep a level head. Yum yum!
(That seems to have worked all right.)
Okay, I'll have a beer.
Suzuki-san, I wasn't asking what you wanted to order.
Oh. You weren't?
Of course not! What are you thinking? First, you guys have to introduce yourselves. Get with the program, bro!
WAAAAHAHAHA! This guy's friggin' hilarious!
*giggle*
(That probably wasn't the right call, but at least I got a reaction out of it.)
All right, let's get to our introductions. You can go first, Muramatsu-san.
Okay. Uh... My name is Tomoaki Muramatsu. I... am a taxi driver. And, um...
(It looks like Muramatsu-san is floundering over there. Maybe I should help him out.)
Do you have any hobbies, Muramatsu-san?
Hobbies, huh... Oh, yeah. I like cars. Cars are great. The more you pour your heart into them, the more they give back.
I think I was five when I first started getting serious about them. My dad loved to race, and he'd take me along in the passenger's seat, a knowing twinkle in his eye...

(He's gonna keep on going forever with that story, isn't he?
I shouldn't have brought up the subject... Too late now.)
Just spit something out already. Is it really that hard?

Hey, I'm trying! No need to hurt my feelings... And, last I
checked, I have seniority over you!
No, you're right. What was I thinking...?
Hey, quit squabbling, boys! You're totally killing the mood.
(That was a bad call. Muramatsu-san isn't the type of guy I can just speak freely with.)
How about you tell us what type of women you like?

Oh... Okay. Let's see. I like girls who are organized.
And diligent, I guess. They should be able to take care
of themselves, at least on a basic level.
Oh, well that describes me perfectly! You're quite forward, Muramatsu-san.
Maybe he likes you! Ahah... Ahahah!
I can tell you're the diligent type yourself, Muramatsu-san. I think that's great.
You do? Heheh.
(That seems to have livened up the conversation. I guess this topic works well at mixers.)
All right, that's all the introductions. Seems like everyone's having a good time, I hope. Now what's next, Suzuki-san?
Well... Let me think.
I think it's time we got the check. I'll call a waiter.
Already!?
Hey, we barely got here! Are you trying to tell us we aren't worth your time!?
Then what's the big deal!? You're acting so rude!
Um, uh... Hey, I know! Let's start over by playing a game! How about the king's game?
King's game? Hmm, tempting... But I'm not sure I'm up to it.
Oh come on, that's practically standard procedure at a mixer! Let's just do it. I'll go first.
You can't just volunteer yourself...
(Looks like I messed up. I guess it was a little early to settle the bill.)
Let's talk about what it means to be a real man. I'm sure that's something we can all relate to.
...You sure about that?
Suzuki-san, this is not the right occasion to go all chauvinistic. Even if you do mean well.
Why yes!? Besides, what do you mean by "a real man"? Is that supposed to be you?
Ooh, she got you with a sick burn! Ahahahaha!
Gee, I never pegged you as the narcissistic type, Suzuki-san.
But I was trying to talk about values... Good things.
Moving right along... Oh, I know! Let's play a game! How about the king's game?
Hmm... Not really sure I'm feeling that.
It looks like they misunderstood me... But it looks like everyone got a kick out of it.
Well, we're hitting it off pretty nicely, so how about we play a game? Who wants to do the king's game?
King's game? Ooh, I don't really know... Should I?

Oh, come on! That's what everybody does at these mixers!
Let's just go for it! Me first!
Perfect! Just what we need to liven things up! Way to go, Suzuki-san!
(That went over well. I'm actually impressed I thought that up.)
Okay, everyone's drawn a straw, right? Whoever gets the red one is the king. They get to call the shots.
The rest of the straws have numbers on them. You use them when you want to make a dare!
For example, you could dare number three to kiss number five! Heheh.
Oh, you boys and your kissing games! You just can't wait to plant a nice, big wet one on me, can you?
Anyway! Let's give it a go! Are you ready? Who... will be our king tonight!?
...It's me.
Oho! So you make the first dare, Suzuki-san.
Aww, I wanted it to be me. Okay, then. What's your dare?
Hmm... Let me think.
Suzuki-san? Hey, uh...
Just so you know... I'm number three. Muramatsu-san is number four. And that cute girl Kondo-san is number two. I glanced over and checked.
Okay. So what do you want me to do?
Well, how do I say this? You know Muramatsu-san and I have our eyes on Kondo-san, right? Maybe you could help us out a little?
I'm trusting you, man! We're at your mercy here!
Hey, what were you two whispering about there? Oh, I know.

You're talking about who you want to sex up tonight, aren't
you? You and your dirty minds! If only you thought with your
big head and not your small one, you just might win me over!
Yahahahaha! You tell 'em, girl!
I'm sure life must be a breeze for you ladies...
(Kiyokawa wants me to set him up, but Kondo-san didn't sound all that enthusiastic about this. How do I keep everyone happy?)
Okay, what say you, our mighty and benevolent king? It's your call.
All hail the king!
The king must make up his mind here...
Okay... I dare number two to massage my shoulders!
Number two? Who's number two?
Oh, it's me.

Uh-oh! Then you better go rub Suzuki-san's shoulders, girl!
Too bad you missed out on <Italic>these</Italic> lovely fingers⑬I could've
rubbed you into the next century!
Yeah, or I could've rubbed you into the next millennium! Haw haw haaaw!
I can't believe you, Your Majesty! You stabbed me in the back! I've been betrayed!
(Kiyokawa may not be happy, but at least this doesn't cause a scene. I'd call that a success.)
Okay... I dare number three and four to kiss!
What!? You're a bastard, Suzuki-san!
Huh? I don't get it. Are you number three, Kiyokawa-kun? Who's number four, then?
Whoooooaaa hohohoho! This oughta be good! Now kiss! <Italic>Kiss!</Italic>
Smooch smooch smooch!

I'll never forgive you for this, Suzuki-san! ...Okay then,
Muramatsu-san. Here I come.
WEEEEHEEHEEHEEHEE! What a riot!
Most def! You guys suit each other, you know that?
(Well, that got everyone in good spirits. I hope the others agree it was worth the trade-off. I'd call it a success.)
Okay, I dare number two and three to kiss!
Here I am! Number three, ready for service! Who's number two?
That's... That's me.
Okay then! Better obey our king, right!? Besides, we might as well enjoy⑬
No! No way. I just can't do it! I'm sorry...
You know what? You're right. Sorry, I got a bit too carried away there. Hope I didn't kill the buzz too much.
(I should've known that would be a wet blanket over everything. Kondo-san didn't even want to play this in the first place. Sorry, guys.)
I... think I should get going now.
Hmm, well, it is getting late. Let's wrap things up, eh?
Whew... I'm stuffed like a turkey.
So, Muramatsu-san, which girl did you like?
Do you even have to ask? Kondo-san, of course.
Right. Same here. She looked like the hard-working, pure-hearted type. Wish I could get me a girl like her.
Yeah... Tell me about it.
(What's goin' on there?)
(An accident?)
Thank you so much. You saved us.
You all right? That was close.
Sir, if it weren't for you, this would have been a terrible disaster. I don't have the words to thank you...
This isn't very much, but we want you to have it.
And if you're willing, we'd love for you to meet our managers at the zoo. They'll want to thank you in person.
(Can't stick around. Don't want the cops to notice me.)
Sorry, I gotta get goin'.
Oh, but... It's all because of you that no one got hurt...
Yeah, but it's fine. I'll just accept yer thanks and be on my way.
What a guy. He knocked out a bear with just his fists.
No one will believe us...
Uh... Um, Sawamura-san?
Huh? Yes?
Um, I'm Kazumi. I go to the same school as you.
Oh, you do? Did... you need me for something?
Sawamura-san, you know someone named Akiyama-san, don't you?
Yes, I know him.
Well, Akiyama-san rescued me. He saved me from having to go out with men for money. The girls from school were trying to make me do it.
Really? Goodness...
Akiyama-san kept me safe. He's an amazing person, isn't he?
Yes, he is.
And, uh, Sawamura-san, if I see you at school, would it be okay if I said hi?
I... I don't have any friends at school. I was hoping maybe I could chat with you if I see you... If you don't mind, of course.
Oh... Of course! I'd love to chat with you!
Yes! Thank you, Haruka! See you at school!
(Haha. Thanks to Akiyama-san, I just made a friend. I need to thank him next time.)
(Where to?)
(Where should I go?)
(Now, where to?)
(Okay, where do I want to go?)
(No, forget it.)
(No, let's stick around here.)
(No. Not yet.)
(No, let's not leave yet.)
(No, I should stay.)
Hello, and welcome.
(Ooh, this lady's pretty cute. Is she an office worker? What's she gonna buy?)
Um... just this.
(Whoa! It's a pair of panties! I didn't know convenience stores sold these. So, the thing I should be asking her is...)
